##### Project general facts

Tessera – Al Ghurair stands as an extraordinary residential masterpiece, conceived by the internationally celebrated Portuguese studio Aires Mateus, led by brothers Manuel and Francisco. The development introduces an architecture of subtraction, where mass is removed, voids are carved, and frontages are drawn back to forge a monolithic form shaped as much by absence as by presence, giving the building a strikingly floating silhouette. Landscape‑graded walkways beneath the structure open onto dedicated amenity zones, delivering a grounded yet elevated living experience.

Residents are welcomed by a resort‑style rooftop swimming pool embraced by verdant planting, creating a tranquil oasis above the cityscape. Complementary facilities include both indoor and outdoor gyms, a dedicated yoga studio, and children’s play areas that span interior and exterior realms. An array of outdoor dining settings, an open‑air cinema, and versatile social and co‑working lounges further enrich daily life.

Each home arrives with a fitted kitchen and bathroom, presenting a refined, move‑in‑ready environment. Interiors showcase modern finishing with high‑quality materials, ensuring a cohesive aesthetic throughout. The overall palette balances simplicity with subtle elegance, reflecting meticulous attention to detail.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South emerges as a visionary and rapidly evolving district, meticulously master‑planned to intertwine residential, commercial, and leisure realms for seamless daily convenience. Pulse Mall and Expo City sit just moments away, offering vibrant retail and cultural experiences within easy reach. Al Maktoum International Airport anchors the area with robust global connectivity for frequent travelers.

The neighbourhood grants swift access to Dubai Marina, JBR, Palm Jumeirah, and Palm Jebel Ali, positioning iconic waterfront destinations within comfortable distance. Mall of the Emirates and the iconic Burj Khalifa lie nearby, while Dubai International Airport ensures smooth onward journeys. This network of links renders the city’s celebrated attractions effortlessly attainable.

Beyond connectivity, Dubai South presents a wealth of attractions ranging from world‑class shopping and gourmet dining to pristine beaches and cultural landmarks. The community’s welcoming atmosphere combines thoughtfully designed infrastructure with ample green spaces, fostering a vibrant lifestyle for families and professionals alike. This balanced environment cultivates both serenity and dynamism, embodying the best of contemporary urban living.
